principles: Substance before style — the work speaks; decoration must earn its place.
Orchestration as metaphor — every layout, motif, and typographic choice encodes disparate parts resolved into one coherent system.
Editorial restraint — spacious layouts, measured type scales, ink-and-paper contrast; no visual noise.
Signal economy — indigo is a signal colour, never a flood; a single focal dot carries the accent.
The score made visible — concentric dot-fields and barline rhythm render orchestration as a structural system, not a picture of instruments.

density.note: measured whitespace, generous section spacing; the dot family never crowds a surface

contrast.note: Concert Black (#0B0B0C) against Cream (#F4F1EA); 60/30/10 black/cream/indigo; depth carried by colour, shadows deliberately minimal

symmetry.note: misaligned section numerals (cream + offset indigo), off-register focal dot; balanced structured grids underneath

geometry.note: polar dot lattice (dot-dome, dot-field) + rectilinear barline measures; dots are true circles, rules orthogonal with round linecaps

typeExpression.note: Fraunces display/headline (authored, calm), Space Grotesk wordmark + labels (open tracking), Plus Jakarta Sans body, IBM Plex Mono metadata

imageTreatment.note: orchestral + architectural photography, desaturated/high-contrast, indigo-toned overlay (opacity 0.62); tight crops — full direction owned by Pillar 5

motifProminence.note: dot-dome (identity), dot-field (texture), barline (rhythm) are integral to layouts, assigned by role

colorRhythm.note: Concert Black heroes/dividers alternate with Cream/White content; indigo as the singular signal

ornament.note: one focal dot per composition; no decorative motif flood; the stage-light radial is hero-only

signatureElements: Dot-dome — the primary mark: a polar lattice of dots forming an orchestra dome with one indigo focal dot at the podium; the rising-ensemble signature.
Concentric dot-field — rings of dots radiating from a single indigo focal; full-bleed texture for heroes and dividers; drives the field-breathe motion.
Barline measure — abstract vertical barlines with beat-dots and one indigo accent beat; rhythm and structure motif for footers, rails, and content grids.
Misaligned numeral — large Fraunces section numbers split cream/indigo with a deliberate baseline offset; the 'scored' editorial cue.
Space Grotesk wordmark — STROMY set in Space Grotesk 600 with open tracking, rising from the dot-dome; primary identity lockup.
Misaligned secondary lockup — the 'scored' STROMY wordmark for cover slides, home-page heroes, and section openers.
antiPatterns: No literal musical notation — no staves, clefs, or noteheads; orchestration is rendered through abstract dots, not sheet music.
No orange or Claude-adjacent accent — indigo (#61009E) is the only signal colour; the retired oxide/orange must not reappear.
No gradient floods on working surfaces — the stage-light radial is a hero-only device; content and document backgrounds stay flat.
No decorative motif scatter — the dot family is assigned by role (dome=identity, field=texture, barline=rhythm), never sprinkled for taste.
No pure-white document grounds where Cream is specified; no stock-office or AI-futurism imagery.
Never more than one indigo focal dot in a single composition — the signal is singular.
